title: mail-server: Email/set create ignores header:* properties
description: Found in JMAP-u6c5. The Email/set create handler composes the message from the convenience properties (from, to, subject, messageId, sentAt, ...) and body parts, but ignores header:<Name>[:as<Form>] properties on the Email and on EmailBodyPart objects. RFC 8621 4.6 lets a client set any header field that way ('the client must set each header field as an individual property') and forbids two properties for the same field. Fix: map header:* properties to jmap_mime::writer::Header values in compose (top-level and per part), reject duplicates and Content-* on the Email as invalidProperties.
